newsitem.title: USA: OLS Asia to list unit, offer up to 30 pct.
newsitem.headline: OLS Asia to list unit, offer up to 30 pct.

text.p: OLS Asia Holdings Ltd said on Monday it plans to restructure so it can list its main operating subsidiary on the exchange in Hong Kong, where the unit is based.
Between 25 percent and 30 percent of the newly listed company would be made available through an initial public offering, with the balance retained by the parent OLS.
The listing is expected to raise funds for the operating subsidiary and speed its further expansion into Asia from mid-year, OLS said.
OLS said it would transfer control of all the fit-out and construction operations of its existing subsidiaries into a wholly owned new listing vehicle, OLS Group Ltd.
OLS Group Ltd's offering would be underwritten by NatWest Securities Hong Kong Ltd, OLS said.
The subsidiary would focus on the construction business while the parent OLS concentrates on property investments and other areas.
A special shareholders meeting for OLS Asia Holdings has been set for May 13 in Melbourne, Australia, to consider the proposed restructuring.
